jobs_results.title: Software Engineer- Frontend (React)
jobs_results.description:
About the role




 Edstem Technologies is looking for Frontend Software Engineers to build fast, accessible, high-quality web applications using React. You'll work closely with designers, backend engineers and product teams to turn ideas into polished user experiences. AI-assisted development with Claude is part of how we work every day, so you'll be expected to use it as a core part of your engineering workflow.




 Key responsibilities




 Build new user-facing features using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript

 Turn designs and wireframes (Figma or similar) into clean, pixel-accurate, responsive code

 Build reusable components and front-end libraries for use across projects

 Use Claude (Claude Code or the Claude app) to speed up coding, refactoring, debugging, test writing and documentation, while staying responsible for the quality and correctness of the code

 Integrate with RESTful APIs and WebSocket services

 Optimize components for performance across browsers and devices

 Write unit and integration tests and help keep code quality high

 Participate in code reviews, including reviews of AI-generated code, and give constructive feedback

 Work with team members and stakeholders to deliver the best user experience

 Keep up with emerging front-end technologies and AI-assisted development practices




 Required skills and experience




 3–7 years of front-end development experience, with at least 3 years in React

 Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), including DOM manipulation and the JavaScript object model

 Solid experience with React hooks, component design and state management (Redux / Redux Toolkit or similar)

 Working knowledge of TypeScript

 Hands-on experience coding with Claude, such as generating and refactoring code, writing tests, debugging and reviewing output critically

 Experience with RESTful APIs and WebSocket services

 Deep understanding of HTML5, CSS3, responsive design and cross-browser compatibility

 Familiarity with modern build tools and pipelines (Vite, Webpack, Babel, ESLint)

 Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows

 Experience with testing tools such as Jest and React Testing Library

 Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills




 Good to have




 Experience with Next.js or server-side rendering

 Knowledge of web accessibility (WCAG) and performance tooling (Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals)

 Experience with CSS frameworks or styling approaches (Tailwind, Styled Components, Material UI)

 Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and cloud deployment




 Location and language




 Candidates from Kerala are strongly preferred

 Must be able to work from Trivandrum

 Strong English communication skills along with fluency in Malayalam (spoken) is preferred.

jobs_results.title: Frontend Developer  React.js, TypeScript & Shopify (Gurugram)
jobs_results.description:
Location: Gurgaon

Employment Type: Full-Time | In-Office 

Experience: 25 Years

Core Skills: React.js  TypeScript  JavaScript  Shopify  Liquid  HTML  CSS

About Aumraa

Aumraa is building a modern devotional platform rooted in Sanatan traditions, bringing together devotional experiences, spiritual guidance, sacred commerce, temples, content, and community within one connected experience. 

Our goal is to make everyday engagement with faith more accessible, thoughtful, and relevant by combining Indian devotional traditions with contemporary product thinking and technology.

We are looking for a Frontend Developer who can independently own our Shopify storefront while contributing meaningfully to Aumraas React-based web applications and internal platforms. This is a hands-on role for someone who can take frontend requirements from design and product thinking through development, testing and production deployment.

What Youll Do

Shopify Storefront Development

- Own the development, maintenance and continuous improvement of Aumraas Shopify storefront
- Build and customise Shopify experiences using Liquid, HTML, CSS and JavaScript
- Develop custom sections, blocks, snippets, templates and reusable storefront components
- Extend Shopify themes beyond standard theme-editor capabilities
- Translate Figma designs into responsive, production-ready storefront experiences
- Build and improve product pages, collection pages, search, navigation, cart, landing pages and campaign experiences
- Work with metafields, metaobjects, templates and collection logic where required
- Build reusable sections that allow business and content teams to manage storefront content with minimal developer dependency
- Troubleshoot Shopify theme issues, app conflicts and frontend bugs

React.js & Web Application Development

- Develop, test and maintain web applications using React.js and TypeScript
- Build reusable, modular frontend components using functional components and React Hooks
- Work with state management using Redux Toolkit, Context API or similar approaches
- Develop interfaces including dashboards, forms, tables, filters, search, navigation, content-management screens and operational workflows
- Implement routing, validations, application states and user interactions
- Refactor and improve existing frontend components where required
- Contribute to the continued improvement of Aumraas existing and future React-based products 

API Integration & Application Logic

- Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs and backend services
- Handle data fetching, submissions, validations and error responses
- Work with authentication tokens, session handling and permission-based interfaces
- Implement loading, empty, success and error states across frontend workflows 
- Collaborate with backend developers on API requirements and data structures
- Debug frontend and API integration issues independently

Responsive UI & Design Implementation

- Translate Figma designs, wireframes and prototypes into high-quality production interfaces
- Build responsive layouts using modern HTML, CSS, Flexbox and Grid
- Ensure consistent experiences across desktop, tablet and mobile
- Maintain accuracy in layout, typography, spacing, interactions and responsive behaviour
- Ensure cross-browser compatibility across major browsers
- Work closely with UI/UX designers to identify technical limitations and edge cases before development

Frontend Performance & Optimisation

- Monitor and improve page-load speed and frontend performance
- Optimise JavaScript, CSS and component rendering
- Reduce unnecessary React re-renders and inefficient frontend logic
- Monitor and improve Core Web Vitals on Shopify
- Identify unnecessary Shopify apps, scripts and third-party dependencies affecting performance
- Use browser developer tools and performance-auditing tools to identify and resolve issues

E-commerce, Growth & Integrations

- Build marketing landing pages, promotional pages and product-launch experiences
- Support frontend improvements across product discovery, navigation, merchandising and cart journeys
- Implement frontend changes based on business requirements, analytics and customer behaviour
- Support simple CRO and A/B testing implementations where required
- Integrate and configure Shopify apps for reviews, bundles, upselling, analytics and customer engagement
- Support integrations with GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, Klaviyo or similar platforms
- Ensure third-party scripts and apps do not unnecessarily impact storefront performance

Testing, Release & Code Quality

- Test features thoroughly before production deployment
- Perform responsive and cross-browser testing
- Validate forms, interactions and API-driven workflows
- Troubleshoot production issues and resolve regressions
- Write clean, modular and maintainable JavaScript and TypeScript
- Use Git / GitHub or equivalent version control
- Work with branches, pull requests and code .
